threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when someone mentions the 'halfie' doors—everyone here knows they’re not just a style choice.
Last night, a couple near me on the 196 bus were reenacting their worst dates. Everyone laughed, even the grumpy driver cracked a smile.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I saw a guy juggling flaming torches in front of the Spätkauf while the kebab shop was blasting 90s techno. Classic Neukölln moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a waste container painted as a street musician. It’s a quirky reminder that art is everywhere here, even in the bins.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Real locals know to avoid the Civic Center BART station after a loud bang—only tourists would be confused by the evacuation.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling on the bus while a woman nervously checked her watch. Only in the Tenderloin do you get a performance and a panic in one ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the locals are sipping wine in the Plaça just for the vibe. Nah, we’re just trying to avoid the overpriced drinks and enjoy the shade.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still marveling at how many gelato flavors there are while holding a massive cone—everyone else just gets a standard one.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Overground' instead of the 'Sandy' line. Locals don’t even blink when the train's late.
Last night on the 159, a couple argued over whether their kebab was 'too dry' while a saxophonist played his heart out near the back.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy with a pet goat casually munching on leaves outside a Kebab shop on Sonnenallee. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a bar where you can drink craft beer while simultaneously browsing a library of vinyl records. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their disdain for tourists blocking the sidewalk while taking selfies at the murals. We just know to keep moving.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus today that suddenly stopped for a pigeon crossing. The driver just sighed, shook his head, and waited. Only in San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think plaça del Sol is the best spot to chill, but the locals know the hidden benches on carrer de Providència have the real vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a recent arrival by how they order their café. They’ll ask for milk in a cortado, not knowing it's sacrilege in Barcelona.
